title: Simple Cargos
description: A wildly advanced yet super fun cargo delivery system for your Survival SMP!
body:
# Simple Cargos

Despite the name, this might just be the _coolest_ delivery plugin out there!

![cargo landing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68ee91f2eef137cdf8e2dd7aca7492ee781c7b9a.png)

## What does it do?

Simple Cargos allows players to easily send items to each other using clean, intuitive GUIs.

During the delivery, a nice particle animation descends from the sky before spawning a chest at the recipient’s location.

Despite the visual effects, the plugin is **lightweight and optimized**, making it perfect for small servers that want functionality without the bloat.

![cool animation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8432e0bfce62a936c19080d313990d7e4d00a442.gif)

> GIF heavily compressed

## Usage


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

### Command:

```
/cargo
```
**permission**: 
```
simplecargos.use
```

> By default, all players are allowed to use this command.

Once executed, a **Cargo NPC (villager)** will spawn near the player.

![villager npc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0cf3290479f9b3fb12f98d2b0a808d8e88dd217.png)

**Right-click** the villager to open a GUI where you can deposit your delivery items.

![GUI example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e75a04b02e566fbc57f9c3cf1387b13427121538_0.webp)


Then, **sneak and right-click** the NPC again to open a menu showing the heads of all online players. Select a recipient to initiate the delivery.

![Delivery GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8c1258d784f94af061bf57b77197e709a6f9689.png)

</details>


## Additional notes:

- This plugin is intended for small-scale, casual servers rather than large commercial networks with strict policies against duplication or potential exploits. (Originally developed for private use, but released for public access.)

- Some exploits may exist. For example, infinite storage is currently possible since there's no spawn cooldown for NPCs.

- These issues may be addressed in future updates.

- Tested on Paper, but should work with other Paper forks (e.g., Purpur, Pufferfish) as well as Spigot and Bukkit, since it relies solely on the Bukkit API.

- Not currently tested on Folia. Compatibility is not guaranteed, as the plugin uses global scheduler calls and modifies entities and world state without region-based context.

- Java 21+ is required.
